items.title: Section: The Fraudulent Teacher — Failure Through Wrong Conduct

items.zh: 邪行所作瑜伽壞者，謂如有一，不如正理精勤修行，雖多用功，無所成辦，不能成辦一切瑜伽，亦非善法。又如有一，多諸煩惱，性多塵穢，而識聰銳，覺慧猛利，成俱生覺，善攝所聞；於聞究竟，或少或多。或住空閑，有在家者及出家者，為性質直，來至其所，因為說法，令心歡喜。又行矯詐，妄現種種身語相應調善所作。由是因緣，招集利養恭敬稱頌、大福德想，及得種種衣、食、臥具、病緣醫藥資身什物，為諸國王、大臣、居士乃至商主恭敬尊重，咸共謂之是阿羅漢。或於隨彼迴轉弟子，若諸出家、若在家眾，戀著親愛，隨順而轉。為多招引，復生是念：此諸出家在家弟子，信順於我，咸共謂我是阿羅漢。彼若依於瑜伽作意止觀等處來請問我，我得彼問或不能對，彼因是事，當於我所捨信向心，不復謂我是阿羅漢，由斯退失利養恭敬。我於今者，應自思惟、籌量、觀察，安立瑜伽。彼由是事增上力故，耽著利養恭敬名譽，獨處空閑，自諦思惟、籌量、觀察，安立瑜伽。然此瑜伽，不順契經、不現戒律、違逆法性。若諸比丘善持三藏，彼於其所覆自瑜伽，不欲開示。若諸在家、出家弟子，於此瑜伽私竊教示，不令彰顯。所以者何？恐有善持三藏教者，聞彼如是瑜伽處已，以經撿驗，不順契經；以律顯照，不現戒律；以法觀察，違逆法性。由是因緣，便不信受，以不信言詰難於我，諍競舉發。由是國王、大臣、居士乃至饒財長者、商主，不復恭敬尊重於我，更不獲得衣、食、臥具、病緣醫藥資身什物。彼由貪著利養恭敬增上力故，於非法中起於法想、起覆藏想、起惡欲樂，顯發開示非法為法。諸有忍許彼所見者，亦於非法起是法想，愚昧頑鈍。於非法中起法想故，雖如其教精進修行，當知一切皆是邪行。如是名為邪行所作瑜伽失壞，像似正法，非真正法，能障正法。
items.en: Failure brought about by wrong conduct refers to one who practices diligently but not in accordance with correct principle, and so, however much effort is expended, accomplishes nothing. There is a further case: one who has many afflictions and a nature much given to defilement, yet whose intelligence is sharp and whose innate discernment is keen … who further practices deceit, falsely displaying various well-composed bodily and verbal conduct. Through this cause, such a one gathers support, reverence, and praise, and a reputation for great merit … until all alike declare him an arhat. … Yet this system he has devised does not accord with the scriptures, departs from the discipline, and runs contrary to the true nature of things. … This is called the failure of yogic practice brought about by wrong conduct — resembling true dharma, yet not true dharma at all, and in fact obstructing the true dharma.

items.title: Section: Yogic Practice Itself Opens — Faith's Two Aspects and Two Bases

items.zh: 諸有比丘勤修靜慮，是瑜伽師，於此四種瑜伽壞法，應正遍知，當遠捨離。云何瑜伽？謂四瑜伽。何等為四？一、信，二、欲，三、精進，四、方便。當知其信有二行相及二依處。二行相者，一、信順行相，二、清淨行相。二依處者，一、觀察諸法道理依處，二、信解補特伽羅神力依處。
items.en: Any monk diligently cultivating absorption, being a yoga practitioner, should fully understand these four kinds of failure of yogic practice and should keep far from them. What is yogic practice? It is fourfold: faith, aspiration, diligence, and means. Know that faith has two aspects and two bases. The two aspects are: the aspect of trusting compliance, and the aspect of purifying clarity. The two bases are: the basis of observing the principle of phenomena, and the basis of trusting in a person's spiritual power.

items.zh: 欲有四種。何等為四？一、為證得欲，二、為請問欲，三、為修集資糧欲，四、為隨順瑜伽欲。為證得欲者，謂如有一，於上解脫發生希慕，如前廣說。為請問欲者，謂如有一，生希慕已，往僧伽藍，詣諸有識同修梵行成就瑜伽妙智者所，為聽未聞，為聞究竟。為修集資糧欲者，謂如有一，為戒律儀清淨、為根律儀清淨故，於食知量、減省睡眠、正知住中，展轉增勝，發生希慕。為隨順瑜伽欲者，謂於無間加行、殷重加行修習道中，發生希慕、發生欣樂，欲有所作。
items.en: Aspiration is fourfold: the aspiration for realisation, the aspiration to inquire, the aspiration to gather the provisions, and the aspiration to comply with yogic practice. The aspiration for realisation is, for one who has come to long for the highest liberation, as extensively explained earlier. The aspiration to inquire is, for one who has already come to long for it, going to the monastic community, approaching those knowledgeable companions in the holy life who have attained the wondrous wisdom of yogic practice, in order to hear what has not yet been heard and to hear it through to its completion. The aspiration to gather the provisions is longing for ever-increasing excellence in moderate eating, reduced sleep, and clear awareness in conduct. The aspiration to comply with yogic practice is longing and taking delight, wishing to actively engage, within a course of practice pursued without interruption and with earnest care.

blocks.text: A vivid portrait of a fraudulent teacher, and then the answer to "what is yoga?"

"One who practises diligently but not in accordance with correct principle, and so, however much effort is expended, accomplishes nothing." The treatise describes such a person: misunderstanding the teaching, "falsely displaying well-composed bodily and verbal conduct", gathering followers, adding to or subtracting from the teaching (Master Cháng Bǎi: where discipline has six items, they make it eight or ten). Their teaching "resembles true Dharma, yet is not true Dharma, and in fact obstructs it", "until all alike declare him an arhat".

"Any monk diligently cultivating absorption should understand these four kinds of failure and keep far from them." Yoga itself is fourfold: **faith, aspiration, diligence, means**. Venerable Miào Jìng: faith and aspiration are the foundation.

**Faith** has two aspects (trusting compliance, and purifying clarity) and two bases: "observing the principle of phenomena, and trusting in a person's spiritual power". Venerable Miào Jìng: the first is wiser.

For **realisation** (longing for liberation); to **inquire** ("approaching knowledgeable companions in the holy life who have attained yoga's wisdom"); to **gather provisions**; to **comply with yoga**.
The fraudulent teacher is not only a historical warning. The same marks (impressive manner, changing the teaching, a following that declares him enlightened) are worth knowing in any age.

quiz.q: What is the first kind of failure through wrong conduct, according to Venerable Miào Jìng?
options: diligent but not by correct principle, so no result however much effort; though sitting long, nothing comes of it
quiz.why: "Failure brought about by wrong conduct refers to one who practices diligently but not in accordance with correct principle, and so, however much effort is expended, accomplishes nothing." Venerable Miào Jìng: though he can sit in meditation for a long time, he will not accomplish anything.

quiz.q: "Practising deceit, falsely displaying well-composed conduct" — what does Master Cháng Bǎi call this?
options: feigned virtue — not having reached that level, yet appearing accomplished and awakened
quiz.why: "Who further practices deceit, falsely displaying various well-composed bodily and verbal conduct." Master Cháng Bǎi: this is feigned virtue — not having reached that level, yet presenting the appearance of practice and attainment.

quiz.q: The text says such yoga "resembles true dharma, yet is not." How does Venerable Miào Jìng explain?
options: somewhat like the Buddha's true dharma, but not the real teaching; learning it obstructs you
quiz.why: "Resembling true dharma, yet not true dharma at all, and in fact obstructing the true dharma." Venerable Miào Jìng: it seems somewhat like the Buddha's true dharma, but it is not the genuine teaching.

quiz.q: After such a deceiver gathers support and reverence, how do people regard him?
options: kings, ministers, householders, and merchants revere him, all declaring him an arhat
quiz.why: "Until all alike declare him an arhat." Venerable Miào Jìng: people say this person is an arhat — that is how it goes.

quiz.q: What are the four components of yogic practice, and which does Venerable Miào Jìng say come before the practice proper?
options: faith, aspiration, diligence, means; faith and aspiration come before practice, diligence is real effort
quiz.why: "What is yogic practice? It is fourfold: faith, aspiration, diligence, and means." Venerable Miào Jìng: faith and aspiration are still things before practising yoga; diligence is when real effort begins.

quiz.q: How do the masters explain the two bases of faith?
options: Miào Jìng: in the basis of observing principles, wisdom stands behind faith; Cháng Bǎi: trusting compliance rests on the basis of a person's spiritual power
quiz.why: "The basis of observing the principle of phenomena, and the basis of trusting in a person's spiritual power." Venerable Miào Jìng: this shows that behind faith lies wisdom — faith is built on wisdom's observation. Master Cháng Bǎi: trusting compliance relies on the basis of a person's spiritual power; purifying clarity relies on observing principles.

quiz.q: What does Venerable Miào Jìng say "行" means in the two aspects of faith?
options: really the mind, active across all objects
quiz.why: "The two aspects are: the aspect of trusting compliance, and the aspect of purifying clarity." Venerable Miào Jìng: the word 行 actually refers to the mind.
